blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-shot personalization enables large vision–language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to 95.0 % 95.0\% while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made significant progress in aligning visual and textual representations Liu et al. [2023] ; Li et al. [2023] . Trained on web-scale image-text corpora, they can answer free-form questions, follow visual instructions, and associate language with fine-grained visual concepts that previously required task-specific architectures Zhang et al. [2024] . These capabilities have enabled applications such as accessibility tools, creative assistants, and consumer photo platforms Xu et al. [2025] .
blocks.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)在调和视觉和文字表述上取得了显著进展. Liu等. [2023]; 李等 [2023] (中文(中国大陆) ). 在网络规模的图像-文本corpora上受训,他们可以回答自由格式的问题,遵循视觉指令,并将语言与先前需要任务特定架构的精致视觉概念联系起来. 张等 [2024]. 这些能力使得诸如无障碍工具,创意助手,以及消费者相片平台等应用程序得以应用. 徐等 [2025].

blocks.en: An increasingly important capability of LVLMs is personalization , which adapts a model to a user-specific visual concept from only a few reference images Pham et al. [2024] . Given several images of a person, a personalized LVLM can learn that individual as a new visual concept and subsequently recognize them in held-out images. This is typically achieved by learning a compact subject-specific representation on top of a frozen backbone Nguyen et al. [2024] ; Alaluf et al. [2024] , enabling personalized assistance, photo organization, identity-aware retrieval, and subject-specific querying Kim et al. [2026] .

blocks.en: While personalization benefits legitimate users, its low cost and few-shot data requirements also make it accessible to adversaries. A few publicly available photos may be sufficient to bind a person’s identity to an LVLM Shi et al. [2025] ; Nguyen et al. [2024] ; Alaluf et al. [2024] . Once personalized, the model can be queried in natural language to determine whether the target appears in new images Bai et al. [2025] . This creates a significant privacy risk: a general-purpose LVLM can be repurposed as a targeted identity recognizer without the person’s knowledge or consent . Unlike conventional face-recognition systems that require dedicated pipelines or specialized models Zhao et al. [2003] ; Laishram et al. [2025] , personalized LVLMs expose identity detection through a flexible prompt-based interface, lowering the barrier to unauthorized use without specialized expertise.

blocks.en: A growing line of work studies image-level protection against unauthorized use, primarily for generative models. Anti-DreamBooth Van Le et al. [2023] , Glaze Shan et al. [2023] , and PhotoGuard Salman et al. [2023] apply visually constrained perturbations to interfere with image editing, style imitation, or subject-driven generation. These defenses target synthesis-based threats, where protection is measured by whether a model fails to edit, mimic, or reproduce protected content Zhao et al. [2025] . Recognition-based personalization poses a different challenge: the model need not synthesize the target identity, but only learn a discriminative representation sufficient for detecting it. Generative defenses are therefore not directly optimized to prevent identity binding or prompt-based recognition in personalized LVLMs, motivating a protection mechanism tailored to this setting and its distinct privacy requirements.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce an image-level protection framework for recognition-based personalization in LVLMs (see Figure 1 ). Our approach follows two key observations. First , personalized LVLMs rely on vision-encoder representations as the visual evidence for identity binding. We therefore optimize protective perturbations in the encoder space rather than attacking a particular prompt response. Second , identity binding relies on cues that remain stable across multiple images of the same person, rather than on memorizing each image independently. Consequently, perturbing an image only with respect to its own representation may leave shared identity cues available for personalization. We address this limitation by aggregating multiple reference representations into an identity prototype and optimizing each protected image to reduce its alignment with this prototype. This directly targets identity-consistent structure rather than only image-specific features.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们为LVLMs基于识别的个性化引入了图像级保护框架(见图一)。 我们的方法遵循了两项关键的意见。 首先,个性化的LVLM依赖于视觉-编码器的表示,作为身份约束的视觉证据. 因此,我们优化了编码器空间的保护扰动,而不是攻击特定的迅速反应。 第二,身份绑定依赖于同一人的多幅图像之间保持稳定的提示,而不是独立地纪念每个图像。 因此,仅仅在形象本身的表述方面扰动其形象,可能会留下共同的身份提示供个人化使用。 我们通过将多种参考表述汇总到一个身份原型,优化每个被保护的图像,以降低其与该原型的配比,来应对这一限制. 这直接针对与身份一致的结构,而不只是图像特有的特征.

blocks.en: In addition to the identity-disruption objective, we refine the perturbation to make the protection effective under realistic image-sharing conditions. Images shared online are often recompressed, which can attenuate high-frequency adversarial signals. We therefore encourage spatial coherence to suppress abrupt local variations and concentrate perturbation energy in lower-frequency components that are less susceptible to JPEG attenuation Wallace [1991] . These refinements are designed to improve perceptual quality and compression resilience while preserving the identity-disruption objective. Because the objective operates on identity-relevant representations rather than a specific query, we evaluate it across prompt formulations. We additionally study transfer when the protection encoder differs from that of the target personalized LVLM.
blocks.zh: 除了身份-破坏目标外,我们完善了扰动,使保护在现实的图像共享条件下有效. 在线共享的图像经常被再压缩,这可以减弱高频对抗信号. 因此,我们鼓励空间一致性,以抑制突然的局部变化,并将扰动能集中在不太容易受JPEG衰减Wallace[1991]的低频组件上。 这些改进是为了提高知觉质量和压缩韧性,同时保留身份破坏目标. 由于目标涉及与身份有关的表述,而不是具体的询问,我们通过迅速的表述来评估。 我们进一步研究当保护编码器与目标个性化LVLM不同时的转移。

blocks.en: Specifically, our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 具体而言,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • We identify and formalize a privacy threat in few-shot personalized LVLMs, in which an adversary can bind an individual’s identity to an LVLM using only a few reference images and later detect that individual in new images through natural-language queries without the target’s consent. We formulate image-level protection for this recognition-based setting, shifting the defense focus from synthesis-oriented misuse in generative models to unauthorized identity binding and recognition. • We propose a multi-reference identity-disruption objective that aggregates encoder representations from multiple reference images into an identity prototype and optimizes protected images to weaken their feature alignment with this prototype. This directly targets identity-consistent cues that recur across multiple reference images rather than image-specific features. • We introduce edge-aware spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation to reduce visible artifacts and improve resilience to JPEG compression while maintaining the identity-disruption objective. • We evaluate Anti-Persona on representative personalized LVLMs, covering both proactive and reactive protection settings. Our method achieves the strongest overall protection among the evaluated methods while preserving visual fidelity. It remains stable across prompt formulations, extends beyond direct presence queries to VQA-style identity queries, and outperforms the evaluated baselines under strict black-box encoder mismatch.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Personalization in LVLMs. Personalization has been extensively studied in generative models, where methods such as DreamBooth Ruiz et al. [2023] , Textual Inversion Gal et al. [2022] , and Custom Diffusion Kumari et al. [2023] adapt text-to-image models to synthesize a specific subject from a few reference images Zhang et al. [2025] . In contrast, personalization in LVLMs is more recent and serves a different purpose: rather than generating images of a subject, the model learns to recognize and interact with user-specific visual concepts in downstream vision-language tasks Pham et al. [2024] . Recent methods such as Yo’LLaVA Nguyen et al. [2024] adopt token-based personalization, where a learned identifier is bound to a target subject, while MyVLM Alaluf et al. [2024] introduces architectural components such as a dedicated concept head for personalized recognition. These approaches show that LVLMs can acquire identity-specific representations from only a small number of examples, enabling applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, this capability also exposes new vulnerabilities, as the same mechanisms that enable efficient personalization can be exploited to inject sensitive identities into models without user consent .

[2024]引入了诸如个人化识别专用概念头等建筑构件. 这些方法表明,LVLMs只能从少数实例中获得特定身份的表示,使得应用程序如个性化检索和对主题的认识查询成为可能. 然而,这种能力也暴露出新的弱点,因为能够实现高效率个性化的同样机制可以被利用,在没有用户同意的情况下将敏感身份注入模型中。

blocks.en: Protection against Unauthorized Personalization. A growing body of work has explored adversarial perturbations as a defense against unauthorized use of personal images by generative AI systems Ma et al. [2026] . General image protection methods such as PhotoGuard Salman et al. [2023] and Glaze Shan et al. [2023] perturb images to resist malicious image editing or style imitation Ye et al. [2025] , while methods such as Anti-DreamBooth Van Le et al. [2023] , MIST Liang and Wu [2023] , Anti-Diffusion Zheng et al. [2025] , and AdvDM Liang et al. [2023] specifically target subject-driven personalization in diffusion models. These approaches are designed for synthesis-based threats, where protection is achieved by preventing a generative model from faithfully editing, mimicking, or reproducing protected visual content. Recognition-based personalization in LVLMs presents a different defense objective. The personalized model need not synthesize the target identity; it only needs to learn a discriminative representation that supports prompt-based identity detection. As a result, defenses designed for generative misuse are not directly optimized to prevent identity binding or subsequent recognition in personalized LVLMs. In this work, we address this gap by formulating image-level protection for recognition-based personalization, where the goal is to disrupt the identity-consistent features used by personalized LVLMs for detection .

blocks.en: Our goal is to construct an imperceptible perturbation δ \delta for a user image x x such that the protected image x ~ = x + δ \tilde{x}=x+\delta is difficult to associate with the target identity s s by a personalized LVLM. We formulate protection in the representation space of the vision encoder, since this is the shared interface through which visual identity information is provided to downstream personalization modules. The design follows three principles. First , the perturbation should disrupt identity-relevant encoder features before they are used for personalization or recognition. Second , because identity personalization is learned from multiple reference images, protection should target the identity-consistent structure shared across those images rather than only image-specific features. Third , the perturbation should remain visually unobtrusive and robust to realistic image processing, particularly lossy compression. We first define an identity prototype that captures the shared identity signal, and then use it to build the protection objective. The overall framework is illustrated in Figure 2 .

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We evaluate whether the proposed protection reduces unauthorized identity recognition while preserving visual fidelity. Our experiments cover reactive and proactive protection, two personalized LVLM architectures, prompt and query variation, black-box encoder transfer, and sensitivity to the number of reference images.
blocks.zh: 我们评价拟议保护是否减少未经授权的身份识别,同时保持视觉忠诚。 我们的实验包括被动和主动的保护,两个个性化的LVLM架构,即时和查询变异,黑盒编码器传输,以及对参考图像数量的敏感性.

blocks.en: Implementation details. We implement the method in PyTorch and generate protected images at 336 × 336 336\times 336 resolution. Unless otherwise stated, pixel-space perturbations use an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} budget of ϵ = 4 / 255 \epsilon=4/255 and are clipped to the valid image range after every update. Spatial smoothing uses a Gaussian kernel with ( σ , k ) = ( 0.8 , 5 ) (\sigma,k)=(0.8,5) . In the gray-box setting, protection is optimized using the victim-aligned OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14@336 encoder Radford et al. [2021] . In the black-box setting, this encoder is never used. Instead, we form a six-encoder surrogate pool comprising CLIP-B/16, CLIP-L/14@224, CLIPA-L/14@336, SigLIP Zhai et al. [2023] , ConvNeXtV2 Woo et al. [2023] , and supervised ViT-L. Each leave-one-surrogate-out configuration optimizes over the remaining five encoders and is evaluated on Yo’LLaVA. Experiments use a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 (48GB) GPU.

blocks.en: Dataset and personalized LVLMs. We use the personalized identity-recognition benchmark from Yo’LLaVA Nguyen et al. [2024] , which contains ten identities with approximately 15–20 images per identity. Following the benchmark protocol, 5–10 images are used as personalization references and the remaining valid images are held out for evaluation. We evaluate Yo’LLaVA Nguyen et al. [2024] , which learns subject-specific identifier tokens, and MyVLM Alaluf et al. [2024] , which trains a lightweight concept head over frozen visual features. These systems represent two distinct encoder-based personalization mechanisms.

[2019] , and PGD Madry et al. [2017] . Each baseline optimizes an instance-level feature-repulsion objective that reduces the similarity between f ϕ ​ ( x ~ ) f_{\phi}(\tilde{x}) and f ϕ ​ ( x ) f_{\phi}(x) , providing a controlled comparison with conventional feature-space perturbations. These baselines use the same perturbation budget and encoder-access regime as ours. For broader comparison, we also report DiffAttack Chen et al. [2024] and WDP Salar et al. [2025] , two unrestricted diffusion-based references. Because they are not ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} -bounded, we distinguish them from equal-budget comparisons and report their visual fidelity. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced an image-level defense against unauthorized identity recognition in personalized LVLMs. Anti-Persona aggregates multiple reference embeddings into an identity prototype and optimizes protected images to disrupt identity-consistent encoder features. Spatial and frequency-domain refinements are designed to preserve visual quality and improve resilience to image compression. Experiments show effective reactive protection on Yo’LLaVA and MyVLM and proactive protection on Yo’LLaVA, while maintaining high visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt formulations, extends to VQA-style identity queries, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch. These results motivate stronger privacy safeguards for personalized multimodal systems.
blocks.zh: 我们在个性化的LVLMs中引入了图像层面的防御,防止未经授权的身份识别. Anti-Persona将多参考嵌入了身份原型,并优化了被保护的图像来破坏身份相容的编码器特性. 空间和频率域的改进旨在维护视觉质量并增强对图像压缩的适应能力。 实验显示对Yo-LlaVA和My-VLM的有效反应保护以及对Yo-LlaVA的主动保护,同时保持高视力的忠诚。 这种方法在快速配方之间保持稳定,可延伸至VQA式身份查询,并改进编码器不匹配下黑箱传输. 这些结果促使对个性化多式联运系统加强隐私保障。
